CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bonded_inventory (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  warehouse_id INT NOT NULL,
  declaration_id INT,
  ucr VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  hs_code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity_kg INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  volume_cbm INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  invoice_value_usd BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  duty_liability_usd BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  origin_country VARCHAR(3),
  deposited_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  expiry_date DATETIME,
  status ENUM('in_bond','ex_bonded','re_exported','destroyed','seized') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'in_bond',
  released_at DATETIME,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  INDEX idx_bi_warehouse (warehouse_id),
  INDEX idx_bi_declaration (declaration_id),
  INDEX idx_bi_ucr (ucr),
  INDEX idx_bi_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ex_bond_permits (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  permit_no VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  inventory_id INT NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INT NOT NULL,
  requested_by_id INT,
  approved_by_id INT,
  quantity_kg INT NOT NULL,
  duty_paid_usd BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  payment_ref VARCHAR(100),
  status ENUM('active','used','expired','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  issued_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  used_at DATETIME,
  expires_at DATETIME,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  INDEX idx_ebp_inventory (inventory_id),
  INDEX idx_ebp_warehouse (warehouse_id),
  INDEX idx_ebp_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cep_patterns (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  pattern_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  status ENUM('enabled','disabled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'enabled',
  parameters JSON NOT NULL,
  trigger_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_triggered_at DATETIME,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  INDEX idx_cep_pattern_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cep_alerts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  alert_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  pattern_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  pattern_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  declaration_id INT,
  trader_id INT,
  severity ENUM('low','medium','high','critical') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
  status ENUM('open','investigating','resolved','false_positive') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  details JSON NOT NULL,
  risk_score INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  assigned_to INT,
  resolved_at DATETIME,
  resolved_by INT,
  resolution_note TEXT,
  detected_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  INDEX idx_cep_alert_pattern (pattern_id),
  INDEX idx_cep_alert_status (status),
  INDEX idx_cep_alert_severity (severity),
  INDEX idx_cep_alert_trader (trader_id),
  INDEX idx_cep_alert_detected (detected_at)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cost_records (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id INT,
  tenant_name VARCHAR(200),
  namespace VARCHAR(100),
  service VARCHAR(100),
  category ENUM('compute','storage','network','database','monitoring','security','other') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'compute',
  period_date DATE NOT NULL,
  compute_cost_usd INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  storage_cost_usd INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  network_cost_usd INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_cost_usd INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cpu_request_millicores INT,
  memory_request_mib INT,
  cpu_usage_millicores INT,
  memory_usage_mib INT,
  efficiency INT,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  INDEX idx_cr_tenant (tenant_id),
  INDEX idx_cr_period (period_date),
  INDEX idx_cr_service (service),
  INDEX idx_cr_category (category)
)
